Verification Summary Report — Pulse Generator Build B2

This report summarises the verification of the component that build B2 (BLD-0002) is a build of, and the components under it. Its scope is the same query as any report about one build: the component whose builds include the report's own build (^^build, read from inside the query on the component's builds), so a report for the next build changes only the build it names.
